text: v1.0.4 is out. Your 1, 2, 4 and 5 are now all in: (1) the paper tier, shipped earlier. (2) The score-event trigger: a score change is looked at immediately, and for 30 s afterwards the app journals every side the model would back, so we can measure how long Novig stays wrong. It records only and places no orders yet, per paper-first. (4) Live bids already get pulled the moment a socket pushes, so nothing new was needed. (5) SX Bet's exchange price is now the first second opinion for live bets, ahead of BoltOdds, on both the phone and the GitHub engine. Tests pass. https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.4
